observations: Official wide view and complete front photograph show a broad lower stair, intermediate terrace and narrower upper stair offset toward the high main building.

limitations: Widths 12/4.8 m, north offset 3.2 m, 1.62/2.52 m platforms, 9/5 risers and 0.32 m tread are estimates, not counted/measured construction data.
No new doorway is inferred. Connections into interior floors, sloping stair-side walls/planting and a complete paved route to campus road remain pending.
